search_text: published ZDI-17-396 ZDI-CAN-4065 Trend Micro Maximum Security tmusa Time-Of-Check/Time-Of-Use Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2017-06-13 6.9 AV:L/AC:M/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Trend Micro'] ['Maximum Security'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privilege on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Maximum Security. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of IOCTL 0x222813. The issue results from a time-of-check/time-of-use vulnerability, which allows an attacker to change a field that is being used by the kernel. title: Trend Micro Maximum Security tmusa Time-Of-Check/Time-Of-Use Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privilege on vulnerable installations of Trend Micro Maximum Security. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of IOCTL 0x222813. The issue results from a time-of-check/time-of-use vulnerability, which allows an attacker to change a field that is being used by the kernel. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to SYSTEM.
